arithmetic.formula: position(T) = start + sign * T under a deterministic tie-break
arithmetic.note: neighbours are never eaten by a single organism, so left == right at every comparison and the tie-break decides every step

silent.evidence: repeating left with seed 20250101 gives the same hash (bc23e7b10b71f188 vs bc23e7b10b71f188)

fires.evidence: left ends at [8], right at [2]: the tie-break changes positions, not only the hash

specific.evidence: positions differ ([8] vs [2], random [8]) AND all three hashes differ, so the contrast is not the embedded name alone

verdict.reason: left and right end at different cells ([8] vs [2]), so the rule is a parameter of the dynamics and not a constant

limitations: One organism on a uniform field with a single seed. This shows the parameter reaches the dynamics; it does NOT show that the original left drift of a population was caused by the tie-break, and it says nothing about `Memory`, where the tie branch is unreachable because the organism eats its own cell before comparing the neighbours.
